After the verb शद् 'to decay', when it has one of the affixes with an indicatory श् (शित्) the आत्मनेपद is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

The affix ड comes in the sense of 'this is surplus in it' after a Numeral ending in शत् and after विंशति with the elision of अत् and अति।

Terms: ड

The following words are anomalous - 1. सद्यः 2. परुत् 3. परारि 4. ऐषमस् 5. परेद्यवि 6. अद्य 7. पूर्वेद्युस् 8. अन्येद्युस् 9. अन्यतरेद्युस् 10. इतरेद्युस् 11. अपरेद्युस् 12. अधरेद्युस् 13. उभयेद्युस् and 14. उत्तरेद्युस्।

Terms: Anomalous

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word सदृश or प्रतिरूप expressing resemblance with someone or something.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

For the final of शद् is substituted त् in the Causative, when it does not mean 'to drive'.

Terms: augment

The स् of सद् is changed to ष after an उपसर्ग (Preposition) having an इ or उ , but not after प्रति।

Terms: षत्व change

The ष् substitution does not take place in the स् of सद् and ष्वञ्ज् after the reduplicate in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

Terms: षत्व change
